job.question: In the minimum-qualifications insurance list of the RFP for oversight of the pension administration system replacing V3, what umbrella-liability and professional-liability limits are specified?
job.expected_facts: The minimum-qualifications list specifies umbrella liability of $5 million per occurrence and $5 million aggregate, and professional liability of $2 million per occurrence and $3 million aggregate. The sample agreement separately contains a wording inconsistency ('one million dollars ($2,000,000)' per occurrence).
job.acceptance: The listed $5m/$5m umbrella and $2m/$3m professional limits are materially correct. Also accept that answer with the p21 written/numeric discrepancy explicitly flagged. Other insurance types and issuer date are optional. Do not accept an unexplained $1m as the sole professional limit.

reviews.reason: This is an RFP for global custody services, not oversight of the pension administration system replacing V3. Its insurance terms differ: umbrella liability is $5 million per incident with no stated aggregate, and professional liability is $1 million per claim with a $2 million annual aggregate. It does not identify these as limits from the requested RFP.
quotes: Request for Proposal Global Custody and Related Services Texas Municipal Retirement System (TMRS)

The primary purpose of this RFP is to identify the most qualified firm to provide global custodial services, recordkeeping / accounting services, performance measurement / analytics, support for an unbundled securities lending program and other services to TMRS as defined in this RFP.
Errors & Omissions (professional liability) insurance with a limit of no less than $1,000,000 per claim made and $2,000,000 annual aggregate;
Umbrella liability insurance with a minimum of $5,000,000 per incident which shall be excess of commercial general liability coverage required herein;
